source_description: Follow-up to mission #53 (drift-interpretation-debug-capture, merged at fbfe2a0f). The code change (env-var-gated debug capture) shipped via #53 WP01; that mission's WP02 was canceled because it required WP01 merged-to-main — a precondition spec-kitty's end-of-mission merge model cannot satisfy within a single mission. This mission ships the operational work: deploy main to office2, enable env var for one tick, capture payload, write diagnostic doc, update runbook, close GitHub issue #404 with findings. References original input: kentonium3/kg-automation#404.
